Mae.reason: MAE refers to the mean absolute error evaluation metric, not a human language, so this is a false positive.

Ganda.reason: Ganda is a subunit in the Ana-Ganda-Kora-Kranti-Til base-16 fraction system, not a human language, so this is a false positive.

Bengali.reason: Bengali refers to the language used in the records and required for legal-QA responses, and the benchmark evaluates models on Bengali data, so it is studied.

Arabic.reason: Arabic refers to Western Arabic digits, a numeral-script notation, rather than the Arabic language, so this is a false positive.
